verdict.rationale: Zapier exposes substantial programmatic surfaces — a Workflow API, SDK, CLI, stored-actions API, and MCP server that can execute the same 9,000+ app actions available in the UI — suggesting broad but not fully verified parity with the visual builder/Canvas/Copilot experience. However, no OpenAPI spec was discoverable (404s on all candidate paths), and there's no explicit documentation confirming that every UI capability (e.g., Canvas mapping, AI troubleshooting, embedded builder) has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/full API reference proving 1:1 UI/API parity, and explicit coverage of Canvas/troubleshooting/embed features via API.
